t: Gir Forest in Gujarat is the only place in the world where Asiatic lions live in the wild.
The Statue of Unity in Gujarat stands 182 metres tall — the tallest statue in the world.
Ahmedabad became India's first UNESCO World Heritage City in 2017.
Rani ki Vav, the stepwell at Patan in Gujarat, is a UNESCO World Heritage Site and appears on the ₹100 note.
Dholavira in Kutch is one of the largest cities of the Harappan civilisation, over 4,500 years old.
The Great Rann of Kutch is one of the largest salt deserts on Earth.
On 23 August 2023, Chandrayaan-3 made India the first country to land near the Moon's south pole.
The Kailasa temple at Ellora was carved top-down out of a single rock, more than 1,200 years ago.
Brahmagupta wrote down rules for calculating with zero in 628 CE.
Chess grew out of chaturanga, a game played in India around the 6th century.
Mawsynram in Meghalaya is one of the wettest places on Earth.
The Ganges river dolphin is India's national aquatic animal. It is almost blind and finds its way with sound.
Indian Railways is one of the world's largest employers, with over a million staff.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
A day on Venus is longer than its year: it spins once every 243 Earth days but orbits the Sun in 225.
Botanically, bananas are berries — and strawberries are not.
Sunlight takes about 8 minutes and 20 seconds to reach Earth.
Tigers have striped skin, not just striped fur.
Elephants can recognise themselves in a mirror — a sign of self-awareness.
Sound travels about four times faster in water than in air.
Our galaxy, the Milky Way, holds an estimated 100 to 400 billion stars.
A teaspoon of neutron-star material would weigh around a billion tonnes.
Hummingbirds can fly backwards.
The Eiffel Tower grows up to about 15 cm taller in summer as its iron expands in the heat.
Honey found in ancient Egyptian tombs, thousands of years old, was still edible.
Your body carries roughly as many bacterial cells as human cells.
Earth's days are slowly getting longer — by about 1.7 milliseconds every century.
Peacocks' tail 'eyes' are made by microscopic structures that bend light, not by pigment.
The Western Ghats are older than the Himalayas and are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Light from the Andromeda galaxy, visible on a dark night, set off about 2.5 million years ago.
Arise, awake, and stop not till the goal is reached.
Where the mind is without fear and the head is held high…
You have a right to your actions, but never to the fruits of your actions.
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
Imagination is more important than knowledge.
The best way to predict the future is to invent it.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Not all those who wander are lost.
That's one small step for a man, one giant leap for mankind.
Look up at the stars and not down at your feet.
वसुधैव कुटुम्बकम्
m: The whole world is one family.

t: सत्यमेव जयते
m: Truth alone triumphs.

t: योगः कर्मसु कौशलम्
m: Yoga is excellence in action.

t: उद्यमेन हि सिध्यन्ति कार्याणि न मनोरथैः
m: Work is achieved by effort, not by mere wishes.

t:
काल करे सो आज कर, आज करे सो अब।
पल में परलय होएगी, बहुरि करेगा कब॥
m: Do tomorrow's work today, and today's work now. The moment may pass — when will you do it then?

t:
धीरे-धीरे रे मना, धीरे सब कुछ होय।
माली सींचे सौ घड़ा, ऋतु आए फल होय॥
m: Patience, mind — all things happen in time. The gardener may pour a hundred pots, but fruit comes only in its season.

t:
बुरा जो देखन मैं चला, बुरा न मिलिया कोय।
जो दिल खोजा आपना, मुझसे बुरा न कोय॥
m: I went looking for the bad in others and found none; when I searched my own heart, I found no one worse than me.

t:
रहिमन धागा प्रेम का, मत तोड़ो चटकाय।
टूटे से फिर ना मिले, मिले गाँठ पड़ जाय॥
m: Don't snap the thread of love — once broken it won't rejoin, and if it does, a knot remains.

t: करत-करत अभ्यास के, जड़मति होत सुजान।
m: With constant practice, even a dull mind becomes wise.

t: जहाँ चाह, वहाँ राह।
m: Where there's a will, there's a way.

t: बूँद-बूँद से घड़ा भरता है।
m: Drop by drop, the pot fills.

t: अधजल गगरी छलकत जाय।
m: A half-filled pot spills the most — shallow people show off.

t: વૈષ્ણવ જન તો તેને કહીએ, જે પીડ પરાઈ જાણે રે।
m: Call them truly good who feel the pain of others.

t: ટીપે ટીપે સરોવર ભરાય.
m: Drop by drop, a lake fills.

t: જેવું વાવો તેવું લણો.
m: As you sow, so shall you reap.

t: મન હોય તો માળવે જવાય.
m: If the heart is willing, even far-off Malwa can be reached.

t: સંપ ત્યાં જંપ.
m: Where there is unity, there is peace.

t: બોલે તેના બોર વેચાય.
m: Those who speak up sell their berries — speak up to get ahead.

t: ઉતાવળા સો બાવરા, ધીરા સો ગંભીર.
m: The hasty get flustered; the patient stay composed.

t:
वृक्षवल्ली आम्हां सोयरीं वनचरें।
पक्षीही सुस्वरें आळविती॥
m: Trees, creepers and forest creatures are our kin; even the birds sing to us sweetly.

t:
जे का रंजले गांजले, त्यांसी म्हणे जो आपुले।
तो चि साधु ओळखावा, देव तेथें चि जाणावा॥
m: Whoever embraces the suffering and downtrodden as their own is a true saint; know that God dwells there.

t: शुद्ध बीजापोटीं फळें रसाळ गोमटीं॥
m: From a pure seed come sweet, lovely fruits: good roots bear good results.

t:
आम्हां घरीं धन शब्दांचींच रत्नें।
शब्दांचींच शस्त्रें यत्न करूं॥
m: Our only wealth is the jewels of words; words are also the weapons we strive with.

t:
सुख पाहतां जवापाडें।
दुःख पर्वताएवढें॥
m: Happiness is the size of a barley grain; sorrow is as big as a mountain.

t: बोले तैसा चाले, त्याची वंदावी पाउलें॥
m: Bow to the footsteps of one who walks as he talks.

t:
मऊ मेणाहूनि आम्ही विष्णुदास।
कठिण वज्रास भेदूं ऐसे॥
m: We servants of God are softer than wax, yet strong enough to pierce a diamond.

t:
असाध्य तें साध्य करितां सायास।
कारण अभ्यास तुका म्हणे॥
m: Says Tuka: the impossible becomes possible with effort; the secret is practice.

t:
ठेविलें अनंतें तैसेंचि राहावें।
चित्तीं असों द्यावें समाधान॥
m: Live as the Infinite has placed you, and keep contentment in your heart.

t:
दुरितांचें तिमिर जावो।
विश्व स्वधर्मसूर्यें पाहो।
जो जें वांछील तो तें लाहो। प्राणिजात॥
m: May the darkness of evil vanish, may the world see the sun of right living, and may every being get what it wishes for.

t:
खळांची व्यंकटी सांडो।
तयां सत्कर्मीं रती वाढो।
भूतां परस्परें पडो। मैत्र जीवांचें॥
m: May the wicked lose their crookedness and come to love good deeds; may all beings be bound in friendship.

t:
माझा मराठाचि बोलु कवतुकें।
परि अमृतातेंहि पैजा जिंके।
ऐसीं अक्षरें रसिकें। मेळवीन॥
m: My Marathi is so sweet it wins a wager even against nectar; I will string together such delightful words.

t:
इवलेंसें रोप लावियेलें द्वारीं।
त्याचा वेलु गेला गगनावेरी॥
m: I planted a tiny sapling at my door, and its vine has grown up to the sky.

t:
रूप पाहतां लोचनीं।
सुख झालें वो साजणी॥
m: Seeing His form with my own eyes, O friend, I am filled with joy.

t:
नाचूं कीर्तनाचे रंगीं।
ज्ञानदीप लावूं जगीं॥
m: Let us dance in the joy of devotional song and light the lamp of knowledge in the world.

t: अमृताहुनी गोड नाम तुझें देवा॥
m: O God, your name is sweeter than nectar.

t:
तीर्थ विठ्ठल क्षेत्र विठ्ठल।
देव विठ्ठल देवपूजा विठ्ठल॥
m: Vitthal is the pilgrimage and the holy place; Vitthal is God and the worship too.

t:
माझें माहेर पंढरी।
आहे भिवरेच्या तीरीं॥
m: Pandharpur on the banks of the Bhima is my mother's home: the place where I truly belong.

t:
विंचू चावला वृश्चिक चावला।
काम क्रोध विंचू चावला॥
m: A scorpion has stung me: the scorpion of desire and anger.

t:
मना सज्जना भक्तिपंथेंचि जावें।
तरी श्रीहरी पाविजेतो स्वभावें॥
m: O good mind, walk the path of devotion, and you will reach God naturally.

t:
प्रभातें मनीं राम चिंतीत जावा।
पुढें वैखरी राम आधीं वदावा॥
m: Think of Rama in your mind at dawn, and let His name be the first word you speak.

t:
जनीं निंद्य तें सर्व सोडूनि द्यावें।
जनीं वंद्य तें सर्व भावें करावें॥
m: Give up everything the world finds shameful; do with all your heart whatever it finds worthy.

t:
जगीं सर्व सुखी असा कोण आहे।
विचारें मना तूंचि शोधूनि पाहें॥
m: Who in this world is completely happy? Think it over, mind, and search for yourself.

t: थेंबे थेंबे तळे साचे.
m: Drop by drop, a lake fills up.

t: नाचता येईना अंगण वाकडे.
m: Can't dance, so the courtyard is crooked: blaming the tools for one's own lack of skill.

t: दुरून डोंगर साजरे.
m: Mountains look lovely from far away: things seem better from a distance.

t: उथळ पाण्याला खळखळाट फार.
m: Shallow water makes the most noise: the less one knows, the more one shows off.

t: गर्वाचे घर खाली.
m: The house of pride comes down: pride goes before a fall.

t: अति तेथे माती.
m: Too much of anything turns to dust.

t: आपला हात जगन्नाथ.
m: Your own hand is your lord: depend on your own effort.

t: कर नाही त्याला डर कशाला?
m: One who has done no wrong has nothing to fear.

t: असतील शिते तर जमतील भुते.
m: Where there's rice, the hangers-on gather: fair-weather friends come with wealth.

t: एक ना धड भाराभर चिंध्या.
m: A heap of rags and not one whole cloth: doing many things and finishing none.

t:
ऐसी वाणी बोलिए, मन का आपा खोय।
औरन को शीतल करे, आपहुं शीतल होय॥
m: Speak words free of ego, words that soothe others and bring calm to yourself too.

t:
साईं इतना दीजिए, जा मे कुटुम समाय।
मैं भी भूखा न रहूँ, साधु न भूखा जाय॥
m: Lord, give me just enough for my family, so that neither I nor a guest at my door goes hungry.

t:
पोथी पढ़ि पढ़ि जग मुआ, पंडित भया न कोय।
ढाई आखर प्रेम का, पढ़े सो पंडित होय॥
m: The world died reading books, yet none became wise; whoever learns the few letters of 'love' is truly learned.

t:
दुख में सुमिरन सब करे, सुख में करे न कोय।
जो सुख में सुमिरन करे, दुख काहे को होय॥
m: Everyone remembers God in sorrow, no one in joy; remember Him in good times and why would sorrow come?

t:
निंदक नियरे राखिए, आँगन कुटी छवाय।
बिन पानी, साबुन बिना, निर्मल करे सुभाय॥
m: Keep your critic close, even give him a hut in your courtyard: without water or soap he cleans your character.

t:
बड़ा हुआ तो क्या हुआ, जैसे पेड़ खजूर।
पंथी को छाया नहीं, फल लागे अति दूर॥
m: What use is being big like a date palm, giving no shade to travellers and fruit far out of reach?

t:
जाति न पूछो साधु की, पूछ लीजिए ज्ञान।
मोल करो तलवार का, पड़ा रहन दो म्यान॥
m: Don't ask a sage's caste, ask about his wisdom; value the sword, leave the sheath aside.

t:
माटी कहे कुम्हार से, तू क्या रौंदे मोय।
एक दिन ऐसा आएगा, मैं रौंदूंगी तोय॥
m: The clay says to the potter: why do you trample me? One day I will cover you. Nobody stays mighty forever.

t:
गुरु गोविंद दोऊ खड़े, काके लागूं पाँय।
बलिहारी गुरु आपने, गोविंद दियो बताय॥
m: Guru and God both stand before me; whose feet do I touch first? The Guru's, for he showed me God.

t:
कस्तूरी कुंडल बसे, मृग ढूँढे बन माहि।
ऐसे घटि घटि राम है, दुनिया देखे नाहि॥
m: The musk is in the deer's own navel, yet it searches the forest; God lives in every heart, but the world doesn't see.

t:
जिन खोजा तिन पाइया, गहरे पानी पैठ।
मैं बपुरा बूडन डरा, रहा किनारे बैठ॥
m: Those who dived into deep water found the pearls; I, afraid of drowning, just sat on the shore.

t:
तिनका कबहुँ न निंदिये, जो पाँवन तर होय।
कबहुँ उड़ी आँखिन पड़े, तो पीर घनेरी होय॥
m: Never look down on even a blade of grass under your feet; if it flies into your eye, it hurts a lot.

t:
अति का भला न बोलना, अति की भली न चूप।
अति का भला न बरसना, अति की भली न धूप॥
m: Too much talking is bad, and so is too much silence, just as too much rain or too much sun.

t:
माला फेरत जुग भया, फिरा न मन का फेर।
कर का मनका डार दे, मन का मनका फेर॥
m: Ages spent turning the rosary, yet the mind didn't turn; drop the beads in your hand and turn the bead of your mind.

t:
रहिमन देखि बड़ेन को, लघु न दीजिए डारि।
जहाँ काम आवे सुई, कहा करे तरवारि॥
m: Don't throw away small things because you have big ones: where a needle is needed, what can a sword do?

t:
रहिमन पानी राखिए, बिन पानी सब सून।
पानी गए न ऊबरे, मोती, मानुष, चून॥
m: Keep your 'water': lustre, dignity and moisture. Without it the pearl, the person and the flour are all lost.

t:
तरुवर फल नहिं खात है, सरवर पियहि न पान।
कहि रहीम पर काज हित, संपति सँचहि सुजान॥
m: Trees don't eat their own fruit, lakes don't drink their own water; the good gather wealth to help others.

t:
जो रहीम उत्तम प्रकृति, का करि सकत कुसंग।
चंदन विष व्यापत नहीं, लिपटे रहत भुजंग॥
m: Bad company can't spoil a noble nature: snakes coil around sandalwood, yet it never turns poisonous.

t:
बिगरी बात बनै नहीं, लाख करौ किन कोय।
रहिमन फाटे दूध को, मथे न माखन होय॥
m: Once spoilt, a matter can't be mended however hard you try, just as churning curdled milk gives no butter.

t:
तुलसी मीठे बचन ते, सुख उपजत चहुँ ओर।
बसीकरन इक मंत्र है, परिहरु बचन कठोर॥
m: Sweet words spread happiness all around. They are the one spell that wins everyone, so give up harsh speech.

t:
दया धर्म का मूल है, पाप मूल अभिमान।
तुलसी दया न छाँड़िए, जब लग घट में प्राण॥
m: Compassion is the root of righteousness and pride the root of sin; never give up kindness while you live.

t:
तुलसी साथी विपत्ति के, विद्या विनय विवेक।
साहस सुकृत सुसत्यव्रत, राम भरोसो एक॥
m: Your companions in hard times are learning, humility, good sense, courage, good deeds, truthfulness and faith in God.

t:
रघुकुल रीति सदा चलि आई।
प्रान जाहुँ बरु बचनु न जाई॥
m: This has always been the way of Raghu's line: give up life if you must, but never break your word.

t: मैया मोरी, मैं नहिं माखन खायो।
m: "Mother, I didn't eat the butter!": little Krishna's famous innocent fib to Yashoda.

t: मैया मोहि दाऊ बहुत खिझायो।
m: "Mother, big brother Balram teases me so much!": child Krishna complains to Yashoda.

t: जसोदा हरि पालनै झुलावै।
m: Yashoda rocks baby Krishna in the cradle, singing him to sleep.

t: अब पछताए होत क्या, जब चिड़िया चुग गई खेत।
m: What's the use of regret once the birds have eaten the crop? Act in time.

t: नाच न जाने आँगन टेढ़ा।
m: Can't dance, so blames the crooked courtyard.

t: जैसी करनी, वैसी भरनी।
m: As you do, so shall you bear.

t: दूर के ढोल सुहावने।
m: Distant drums sound sweet: things look better from far away.

t: थोथा चना, बाजे घना।
m: An empty gram pod rattles the loudest: empty vessels make the most noise.

t: ऊँची दुकान, फीका पकवान।
m: Grand shop, bland sweets: big show, little substance.

t: एक और एक ग्यारह।
m: One and one make eleven: there is great strength in unity.

t: आम के आम, गुठलियों के दाम।
m: Mangoes to eat, and money for the stones too: a double benefit.

t:
અખિલ બ્રહ્માંડમાં એક તું શ્રીહરિ,
જૂજવે રૂપે અનંત ભાસે.
m: In the whole universe there is only You, Shri Hari, appearing endlessly in different forms.

t:
પર દુઃખે ઉપકાર કરે તોયે,
મન અભિમાન ન આણે રે.
m: They help others in their sorrow, yet never let pride enter their mind.

t:
જાગને જાદવા, કૃષ્ણ ગોવાળિયા,
તુજ વિના ધેનમાં કોણ જાશે?
m: Wake up, Krishna, little cowherd! Without you, who will take the cows to graze?

t:
જળકમળ છાંડી જાને બાળા,
સ્વામી અમારો જાગશે.
m: Leave the lotus pond and go, child, or our master (the serpent Kaliya) will wake up.

t:
જ્યાં લગી આત્મા તત્ત્વ ચીન્યો નહીં,
ત્યાં લગી સાધના સર્વ જૂઠી.
m: Until you know the truth of your own soul, all spiritual practice is hollow.

t:
નીરખને ગગનમાં કોણ ઘૂમી રહ્યો,
તે જ હું તે જ હું શબ્દ બોલે.
m: Look at who roams the whole sky: He says, 'That is I, that is I.'

t:
ભૂતળ ભક્તિ પદારથ મોટું,
બ્રહ્મલોકમાં નાહીં રે.
m: Devotion here on earth is a great treasure, one not found even in Brahma's heaven.

t:
એક મૂરખને એવી ટેવ,
પથ્થર એટલા પૂજે દેવ.
m: A fool has the habit of worshipping every stone as a god.

t:
તિલક કરતાં ત્રેસઠ થયાં,
જપમાળાનાં નાકાં ગયાં.
m: Applying tilak, he turned sixty-three; telling beads, he wore out the rosary, yet found no God. Ritual alone isn't devotion.

t:
દેહાભિમાન હતું પાશેર,
તે વિદ્યા ભણતાં વધ્યું શેર.
m: His ego weighed a quarter-pound; with learning it grew to a full pound. Knowledge without humility only feeds pride.

t:
આંધળો સસરો ને શણગટ વહુ,
કથા સાંભળવા ચાલ્યું સહુ.
m: A blind father-in-law and a veiled daughter-in-law go to hear a sermon: those who can't see the truth, listening blindly.

t:
ભાષાને શું વળગે ભૂર,
જે રણમાં જીતે તે શૂર.
m: Why cling to the language, fool? Whoever wins the battle is the hero. What matters is the meaning, not the words.

t:
શ્યામ રંગ સમીપે ન જાવું,
મારે આજ થકી શ્યામ રંગ સમીપે ન જાવું.
m: From today I won't go near anything dark: a gopi's playful sulk at dark-skinned Krishna.

t:
વ્રજ વહાલું રે,
વૈકુંઠ નહીં આવું.
m: Braj is dear to me; I will not come to Vaikunth. Krishna's land is sweeter than heaven.

t:
હું શું જાણું જે વહાલે,
મુજમાં શું દીઠું?
m: How would I know what my Beloved saw in me?

t:
કરતાં જાળ કરોળિયો, ભોંય પડી ગભરાય;
વણ તૂટેલે તાંતણે, ઉપર ચડવા જાય.
m: Weaving its web, the spider falls to the ground, then climbs back up on its unbroken thread. Never give up.

t:
સાંભળી શિયાળ બોલ્યું, દાખે દલપતરામ,
અન્યનું તો એક વાંકું, આપનાં અઢાર છે.
m: Hearing the camel mock others' crooked parts, the jackal said: others have one crooked part, you have eighteen.

t: જેવો દેશ તેવો વેશ.
m: As the land, so the dress: when in Rome, do as the Romans do.

t: દૂરથી ડુંગર રળિયામણા.
m: Hills look lovely from afar: things seem better from a distance.

t: ધીરજનાં ફળ મીઠાં.
m: The fruits of patience are sweet.

t: ઝાઝા હાથ રળિયામણા.
m: Many hands make work beautiful: many hands make light work.

t: બકરું કાઢતાં ઊંટ પેઠું.
m: Chasing out a goat, a camel walked in: a fix that brings a bigger problem.

t: ભેંસ આગળ ભાગવત.
m: Reciting the Bhagavat to a buffalo: wisdom wasted on someone who won't listen.

t: ખાલી ચણો વાગે ઘણો.
m: An empty gram pod rattles the most: those who know little talk the most.

t: જાગ્યા ત્યારથી સવાર.
m: It's morning from the moment you wake: it's never too late to start.

t: આપ ભલા તો જગ ભલા.
m: Be good yourself and the world will be good to you.

t: ઊંટના અઢારે અંગ વાંકાં.
m: All eighteen parts of a camel are crooked: said of someone full of faults who still points at others.

t: વાડ ચીભડાં ગળે.
m: The fence itself eats the cucumbers: when the protector becomes the thief.

t: જેની લાઠી તેની ભેંસ.
m: Whoever holds the stick owns the buffalo: might is right.
